targets.name: Tests.OnlineLearningChapterAudit.initial_zero_first_regret
targets.header:
theorem initial_zero_first_regret :
    squaredBestRegret (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (ftlPredict 0 (fun _ => 1)) 1 = 1 ∧
      squaredBestRegret (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (ftlPredict 0 (fun _ => 1)) 1 > (1 : ℝ) / 4
targets.conclusion:
squaredBestRegret (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (ftlPredict 0 (fun _ => 1)) 1 = 1 ∧
      squaredBestRegret (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (ftlPredict 0 (fun _ => 1)) 1 > (1 : ℝ) / 4

targets.name: Tests.OnlineLearningChapterAudit.two_round_initial_correction
targets.header:
theorem two_round_initial_correction :
    squaredBestRegret falling (ftlPredict 0 falling) 2 =
      squaredBestRegret falling (meanPredict falling) 2 + (3 : ℝ) / 4
targets.conclusion:
squaredBestRegret falling (ftlPredict 0 falling) 2 =
      squaredBestRegret falling (meanPredict falling) 2 + (3 : ℝ) / 4

targets.name: Tests.OnlineLearningChapterAudit.positive_regret_negative_correction
targets.header:
theorem positive_regret_negative_correction :
    squaredBestRegret rising (ftlPredict 0 rising) 2 = (1 : ℝ) / 2 ∧
      squaredBestRegret rising (meanPredict rising) 2 = (3 : ℝ) / 4 ∧
      ((0 - rising 0)^2 - ((1 : ℝ) / 2 - rising 0)^2) = -(1 : ℝ) / 4
targets.conclusion:
squaredBestRegret rising (ftlPredict 0 rising) 2 = (1 : ℝ) / 2 ∧
      squaredBestRegret rising (meanPredict rising) 2 = (3 : ℝ) / 4 ∧
      ((0 - rising 0)^2 - ((1 : ℝ) / 2 - rising 0)^2) = -(1 : ℝ) / 4

targets.name: Tests.OnlineLearningChapterAudit.general_initial_finite_values
targets.header:
theorem general_initial_finite_values :
    squaredBestRegret falling (ftlPredict 0 falling) 2 = (3 : ℝ) / 2 ∧
      squaredBestRegret falling (ftlPredict 0 falling) 2 ≤ (3 : ℝ) ∧
      squaredBestRegret (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (ftlPredict 0 (fun _ => 1)) 1 ≤ 1
targets.conclusion:
squaredBestRegret falling (ftlPredict 0 falling) 2 = (3 : ℝ) / 2 ∧
      squaredBestRegret falling (ftlPredict 0 falling) 2 ≤ (3 : ℝ) ∧
      squaredBestRegret (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (ftlPredict 0 (fun _ => 1)) 1 ≤ 1

targets.name: Tests.OnlineLearningChapterAudit.same_past_current_reveal
targets.header:
theorem same_past_current_reveal :
    ftlState 0 rising 1 = ftlState 0 (fun _ => 0) 1 ∧
      rising 1 ≠ (0 : ℝ) ∧ ftlState 0 rising 2 ≠ ftlState 0 (fun _ => 0) 2
targets.conclusion:
ftlState 0 rising 1 = ftlState 0 (fun _ => 0) 1 ∧
      rising 1 ≠ (0 : ℝ) ∧ ftlState 0 rising 2 ≠ ftlState 0 (fun _ => 0) 2

targets.name: Tests.OnlineLearningChapterAudit.initialized_state_values
targets.header:
theorem initialized_state_values :
    ftlState ((3 : ℝ) / 4) rising 0 = (0, (3 : ℝ) / 4) ∧
      ftlState ((3 : ℝ) / 4) rising 1 = (1, 0) ∧
      ftlState ((3 : ℝ) / 4) rising 2 = (2, (1 : ℝ) / 2)
targets.conclusion:
ftlState ((3 : ℝ) / 4) rising 0 = (0, (3 : ℝ) / 4) ∧
      ftlState ((3 : ℝ) / 4) rising 1 = (1, 0) ∧
      ftlState ((3 : ℝ) / 4) rising 2 = (2, (1 : ℝ) / 2)

targets.name: Tests.OnlineLearningChapterAudit.all_initial_dyadic_upper
targets.header:
theorem all_initial_dyadic_upper :
    ∀ initial ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      NoRegret (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (fun t x => (x - dyadicObservation t)^2)
        (ftlPredict initial dyadicObservation)
targets.conclusion:
∀ initial ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      NoRegret (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (fun t x => (x - dyadicObservation t)^2)
        (ftlPredict initial dyadicObservation)

targets.name: Tests.OnlineLearningChapterAudit.nonhalf_dyadic_best_average
targets.header:
theorem nonhalf_dyadic_best_average :
    Tendsto (fun T : ℕ => squaredBestRegret dyadicObservation
      (ftlPredict ((3 : ℝ) / 4) dyadicObservation) T / (T : ℝ)) atTop (nhds (0 : ℝ))
targets.conclusion:
Tendsto (fun T : ℕ => squaredBestRegret dyadicObservation
      (ftlPredict ((3 : ℝ) / 4) dyadicObservation) T / (T : ℝ)) atTop (nhds (0 : ℝ))

targets.name: Tests.OnlineLearningChapterAudit.outside_real_initial_identity
targets.header:
theorem outside_real_initial_identity :
    squaredBestRegret (fun _ => (3 : ℝ)) (ftlPredict 2 (fun _ => 3)) 1 =
      squaredBestRegret (fun _ => (3 : ℝ)) (meanPredict (fun _ => 3)) 1 - (21 : ℝ) / 4
targets.conclusion:
squaredBestRegret (fun _ => (3 : ℝ)) (ftlPredict 2 (fun _ => 3)) 1 =
      squaredBestRegret (fun _ => (3 : ℝ)) (meanPredict (fun _ => 3)) 1 - (21 : ℝ) / 4

targets.name: Tests.OnlineLearningChapterAudit.empty_horizon_not_first_correction
targets.header:
theorem empty_horizon_not_first_correction :
    squaredBestRegret falling (ftlPredict 0 falling) 0 = 0 ∧
      squaredBestRegret falling (meanPredict falling) 0 = 0 ∧
      ((0 - falling 0)^2 - ((1 : ℝ) / 2 - falling 0)^2) = (3 : ℝ) / 4
targets.conclusion:
squaredBestRegret falling (ftlPredict 0 falling) 0 = 0 ∧
      squaredBestRegret falling (meanPredict falling) 0 = 0 ∧
      ((0 - falling 0)^2 - ((1 : ℝ) / 2 - falling 0)^2) = (3 : ℝ) / 4

targets.name: Tests.OnlineLearningChapterAudit.best_and_fixed_comparator_distinct
targets.header:
theorem best_and_fixed_comparator_distinct :
    comparatorRegret (fun t x => (x - falling t)^2) (ftlPredict 0 falling) 0 2 = 1 ∧
      squaredBestRegret falling (ftlPredict 0 falling) 2 = (3 : ℝ) / 2
targets.conclusion:
comparatorRegret (fun t x => (x - falling t)^2) (ftlPredict 0 falling) 0 2 = 1 ∧
      squaredBestRegret falling (ftlPredict 0 falling) 2 = (3 : ℝ) / 2

targets.name: Tests.OnlineLearningChapterAudit.positive_iid_variance_excess
targets.header:
theorem positive_iid_variance_excess :
    variance (observation 0) iidLaw = (1 : ℝ) / 4 ∧
      expectedFixedRegret iidLaw observation (fun t ω => meanPredict ω t) 2 = (1 : ℝ) / 4 ∧
      expectedFixedRegret iidLaw observation (fun t ω => meanPredict ω t) 2 / (2 : ℝ) = (1 : ℝ) / 8
targets.conclusion:
variance (observation 0) iidLaw = (1 : ℝ) / 4 ∧
      expectedFixedRegret iidLaw observation (fun t ω => meanPredict ω t) 2 = (1 : ℝ) / 4 ∧
      expectedFixedRegret iidLaw observation (fun t ω => meanPredict ω t) 2 / (2 : ℝ) = (1 : ℝ) / 8

targets.name: Tests.OnlineLearningChapterAudit.population_mean_fixed_minimum
targets.header:
theorem population_mean_fixed_minimum :
    IsLeast ((fun u : ℝ => ∫ ω, ∑ t ∈ Finset.range 2, (u - observation t ω)^2 ∂iidLaw)
      '' Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ((1 : ℝ) / 2) ∧
      expectedFixedRegret iidLaw observation (fun _ _ => (1 / 2 : ℝ)) 2 = 0
targets.conclusion:
IsLeast ((fun u : ℝ => ∫ ω, ∑ t ∈ Finset.range 2, (u - observation t ω)^2 ∂iidLaw)
      '' Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ((1 : ℝ) / 2) ∧
      expectedFixedRegret iidLaw observation (fun _ _ => (1 / 2 : ℝ)) 2 = 0

targets.name: Tests.OnlineLearningChapterAudit.expectation_and_hindsight_distinct
targets.header:
theorem expectation_and_hindsight_distinct :
    (∫ ω, hindsightMinimum ω 2 ∂iidLaw) = (1 : ℝ) / 4 ∧
      expectedFixedMinimum iidLaw observation 2 = (1 : ℝ) / 2
targets.conclusion:
(∫ ω, hindsightMinimum ω 2 ∂iidLaw) = (1 : ℝ) / 4 ∧
      expectedFixedMinimum iidLaw observation 2 = (1 : ℝ) / 2

targets.name: Tests.OnlineLearningChapterAudit.iid_success_total_and_average
targets.header:
theorem iid_success_total_and_average :
    Tendsto (fun T => expectedFixedRegret iidLaw observation (fun t ω => meanPredict ω t) T /
      (T : ℝ)) atTop (nhds (0 : ℝ)) ∧
      (fun T => expectedFixedRegret iidLaw observation (fun t ω => meanPredict ω t) T) =o[atTop]
        (fun T : ℕ => (T : ℝ))
targets.conclusion:
Tendsto (fun T => expectedFixedRegret iidLaw observation (fun t ω => meanPredict ω t) T /
      (T : ℝ)) atTop (nhds (0 : ℝ)) ∧
      (fun T => expectedFixedRegret iidLaw observation (fun t ω => meanPredict ω t) T) =o[atTop]
        (fun T : ℕ => (T : ℝ))

targets.name: Tests.OnlineLearningChapterAudit.loss_sequence_visible_outside_comparators
targets.header:
theorem loss_sequence_visible_outside_comparators :
    (RegretDomainsProbe.output 0).val ∈ RegretDomainsProbe.outputW ∧
      (RegretDomainsProbe.output 0).val ∉ RegretDomainsProbe.sourceV ∧
      comparatorRegret RegretDomainsProbe.domainLoss RegretDomainsProbe.output
        RegretDomainsProbe.referenceOne 2 = -2 ∧
      comparatorRegret (fun t x => 2 * RegretDomainsProbe.domainLoss t x)
        RegretDomainsProbe.output RegretDomainsProbe.referenceOne 2 = -4
targets.conclusion:
(RegretDomainsProbe.output 0).val ∈ RegretDomainsProbe.outputW ∧
      (RegretDomainsProbe.output 0).val ∉ RegretDomainsProbe.sourceV ∧
      comparatorRegret RegretDomainsProbe.domainLoss RegretDomainsProbe.output
        RegretDomainsProbe.referenceOne 2 = -2 ∧
      comparatorRegret (fun t x => 2 * RegretDomainsProbe.domainLoss t x)
        RegretDomainsProbe.output RegretDomainsProbe.referenceOne 2 = -4

targets.name: Tests.OnlineLearningChapterAudit.produced_minimum_and_empty_nonunique
targets.header:
theorem produced_minimum_and_empty_nonunique :
    empiricalMean rising 2 = (1 : ℝ) / 2 ∧
      sInf ((fun u : ℝ => ∑ t ∈ Finset.range 2, (u - rising t)^2) '' Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) = (1 : ℝ) / 2 ∧
      ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, (∑ t ∈ Finset.range 0, (u - rising t)^2) = 0
targets.conclusion:
empiricalMean rising 2 = (1 : ℝ) / 2 ∧
      sInf ((fun u : ℝ => ∑ t ∈ Finset.range 2, (u - rising t)^2) '' Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) = (1 : ℝ) / 2 ∧
      ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, (∑ t ∈ Finset.range 0, (u - rising t)^2) = 0

targets.name: Tests.OnlineLearningChapterAudit.positive_prefix_unique
targets.header:
theorem positive_prefix_unique :
    ∀ u : ℝ,
      (∑ t ∈ Finset.range 2, (u - rising t)^2) ≤
        (∑ t ∈ Finset.range 2, (empiricalMean rising 2 - rising t)^2) → u = (1 : ℝ) / 2
targets.conclusion:
∀ u : ℝ,
      (∑ t ∈ Finset.range 2, (u - rising t)^2) ≤
        (∑ t ∈ Finset.range 2, (empiricalMean rising 2 - rising t)^2) → u = (1 : ℝ) / 2

targets.name: Tests.OnlineLearningChapterAudit.concrete_be_the_leader
targets.header:
theorem concrete_be_the_leader :
    (∑ t ∈ Finset.range 2, ChapterOneCase0.demoLoss t (ChapterOneCase0.demoLeader (t + 1))) = -2 ∧
      (∑ t ∈ Finset.range 2, ChapterOneCase0.demoLoss t (ChapterOneCase0.demoLeader 2)) = 0 ∧
      (∑ t ∈ Finset.range 2, ChapterOneCase0.demoLoss t (ChapterOneCase0.demoLeader (t + 1))) ≤
        ∑ t ∈ Finset.range 2, ChapterOneCase0.demoLoss t (ChapterOneCase0.demoLeader 2)
targets.conclusion:
(∑ t ∈ Finset.range 2, ChapterOneCase0.demoLoss t (ChapterOneCase0.demoLeader (t + 1))) = -2 ∧
      (∑ t ∈ Finset.range 2, ChapterOneCase0.demoLoss t (ChapterOneCase0.demoLeader 2)) = 0 ∧
      (∑ t ∈ Finset.range 2, ChapterOneCase0.demoLoss t (ChapterOneCase0.demoLeader (t + 1))) ≤
        ∑ t ∈ Finset.range 2, ChapterOneCase0.demoLoss t (ChapterOneCase0.demoLeader 2)

targets.name: Tests.OnlineLearningChapterAudit.half_refined_and_logarithmic
targets.header:
theorem half_refined_and_logarithmic :
    squaredBestRegret rising (meanPredict rising) 2 = (3 : ℝ) / 4 ∧
      squaredBestRegret rising (meanPredict rising) 2 ≤ (9 : ℝ) / 4 ∧
      squaredBestRegret rising (meanPredict rising) 2 ≤ 4 + 4 * Real.log 2
targets.conclusion:
squaredBestRegret rising (meanPredict rising) 2 = (3 : ℝ) / 4 ∧
      squaredBestRegret rising (meanPredict rising) 2 ≤ (9 : ℝ) / 4 ∧
      squaredBestRegret rising (meanPredict rising) 2 ≤ 4 + 4 * Real.log 2

targets.name: Tests.OnlineLearningChapterAudit.same_stream_later_stability
targets.header:
theorem same_stream_later_stability :
    (meanPredict rising 1 - rising 1)^2 - (meanPredict rising 2 - rising 1)^2 = (3 : ℝ) / 4 ∧
      (meanPredict rising 1 - rising 1)^2 - (meanPredict rising 2 - rising 1)^2 ≤ 4 / ((1 : ℝ) + 1)
targets.conclusion:
(meanPredict rising 1 - rising 1)^2 - (meanPredict rising 2 - rising 1)^2 = (3 : ℝ) / 4 ∧
      (meanPredict rising 1 - rising 1)^2 - (meanPredict rising 2 - rising 1)^2 ≤ 4 / ((1 : ℝ) + 1)

targets.name: Tests.OnlineLearningChapterAudit.actual_kernel_same_run_excess
targets.header:
theorem actual_kernel_same_run_excess :
    (∀ T : ℕ, expectedFixedRegret Tests.OnlineGuessingKernelCausal.gameLaw
      Tests.OnlineGuessingKernelCausal.target
      (fun t ω => (Tests.OnlineGuessingKernelCausal.prediction t ω : ℝ)) T = (T : ℝ) / 4) ∧

      Tests.OnlineGuessingKernelCausal.decisionKernel 1 (Tests.OnlineGuessingKernelCausal.oneHistory 1 1) {1} = (3 / 4 : ℝ≥0∞)
targets.conclusion:
(∀ T : ℕ, expectedFixedRegret Tests.OnlineGuessingKernelCausal.gameLaw
      Tests.OnlineGuessingKernelCausal.target
      (fun t ω => (Tests.OnlineGuessingKernelCausal.prediction t ω : ℝ)) T = (T : ℝ) / 4) ∧
      Tests.OnlineGuessingKernelCausal.decisionKernel 1 (Tests.OnlineGuessingKernelCausal.oneHistory 0 1) {1} = (1 / 4 : ℝ≥0∞) ∧
      Tests.OnlineGuessingKernelCausal.decisionKernel 1 (Tests.OnlineGuessingKernelCausal.oneHistory 1 1) {1} = (3 / 4 : ℝ≥0∞)

targets.name: Tests.OnlineLearningChapterAudit.correlation_changes_excess
targets.header:
theorem correlation_changes_excess :
    expectedFixedRegret iidLaw (fun _ => observation 0)
      (fun t ω => meanPredict (fun _ => observation 0 ω) t) 2 = -(1 : ℝ) / 4 ∧
      expectedFixedRegret iidLaw observation (fun t ω => meanPredict ω t) 2 = (1 : ℝ) / 4
targets.conclusion:
expectedFixedRegret iidLaw (fun _ => observation 0)
      (fun t ω => meanPredict (fun _ => observation 0 ω) t) 2 = -(1 : ℝ) / 4 ∧
      expectedFixedRegret iidLaw observation (fun t ω => meanPredict ω t) 2 = (1 : ℝ) / 4

targets.name: Tests.OnlineLearningChapterAudit.same_actual_ftl_limit_obstruction
targets.header:
theorem same_actual_ftl_limit_obstruction :
    NoRegret (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (fun t x => (x - dyadicObservation t)^2) (meanPredict dyadicObservation) ∧
      Tendsto (fun T : ℕ => squaredBestRegret dyadicObservation (meanPredict dyadicObservation) T / (T : ℝ)) atTop (nhds (0 : ℝ)) ∧
      (¬ ∃ a : ℝ, Tendsto (fun T : ℕ => comparatorRegret (fun t x => (x - dyadicObservation t)^2)
        (meanPredict dyadicObservation) 0 T / (T : ℝ)) atTop (nhds a)) ∧
      ¬ LimitNoRegret (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (fun t x => (x - dyadicObservation t)^2) (meanPredict dyadicObservation)
targets.conclusion:
NoRegret (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (fun t x => (x - dyadicObservation t)^2) (meanPredict dyadicObservation) ∧
      Tendsto (fun T : ℕ => squaredBestRegret dyadicObservation (meanPredict dyadicObservation) T / (T : ℝ)) atTop (nhds (0 : ℝ)) ∧
      (¬ ∃ a : ℝ, Tendsto (fun T : ℕ => comparatorRegret (fun t x => (x - dyadicObservation t)^2)
        (meanPredict dyadicObservation) 0 T / (T : ℝ)) atTop (nhds a)) ∧
      ¬ LimitNoRegret (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (fun t x => (x - dyadicObservation t)^2) (meanPredict dyadicObservation)

        ∂GuessingLogLowerProbe.coinMeasure
targets.conclusion:
∃ v : List.Vector Bool 2, Real.log 4 / 6 ≤

        ∂GuessingLogLowerProbe.coinMeasure

targets.name: Tests.OnlineLearningChapterAudit.harmonic_two_bound
targets.header:
theorem harmonic_two_bound :
    (harmonic 2 : ℝ) = (3 : ℝ) / 2 ∧ (harmonic 2 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + Real.log 2
targets.conclusion: (harmonic 2 : ℝ) = (3 : ℝ) / 2 ∧ (harmonic 2 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + Real.log 2

targets.name: Tests.OnlineLearningChapterAudit.centered_total_average_boundary
targets.header:
theorem centered_total_average_boundary :
    (fun T : ℕ => (5 + 3 * (T : ℝ)) - (T : ℝ) * 3) =o[atTop]
      (fun T : ℕ => (T : ℝ)) ∧
      ((5 + 3 * (0 : ℝ)) / (0 : ℝ) - 3) = -(3 : ℝ)
